format: traditional, free-standing Bojangles Restaurant (approx. 2,500 to 3,200 sq ft, new construction)

invest.quote: The total investment necessary to begin operation of a traditional, free-standing Bojangles Restaurant is $2,851,880 to $3,951,200. This includes $35,000 that must be paid to us. ... These estimates do not include the cost of acquiring or leasing real estate.

fee.quote: The franchise fee for each Individual Franchise Agreement is $35,000 and is payable upon execution of the Individual Franchise Agreement.
fee.note: Development Agreement (minimum 3 Restaurants): $10,000 development fee per Restaurant, credited against the $35,000 franchise fee. Bojangles Express: $20,000. DIP Program (minorities, women, veterans owning 51%+, DA for 3+ signed by December 31, 2026): franchise fee reduced 50% for the first two qualifying Restaurants and royalty reduced by 3%/2%/1% in Years 1-3. ERI Program: up to $300,000 equipment reimbursement for certain qualifying Restaurants (expires December 31, 2026). In the previous fiscal year fees ranged from $25,000 (grandfathered) to $35,000.

royalty.quote: Royalty 4% of total monthly Gross Sales2,3 15th day of each month

adFund.quote: Marketing Development Fund 1% of total monthly Gross Sales ... Local Marketing Expenditure 3% of total monthly Gross Sales less amounts spent on cooperative advertising
adFund.note: 1% to the Marketing Development Fund plus a required 3% local marketing spend; cooperative advertising (typically 2%, generally maximum 2%) is credited against the local marketing expenditure. Local Marketing advertising technology vendors $153 per Restaurant monthly counts toward the 3%.
